description: This Java class defines a REST API resource for managing email configuration in the Fineract platform. It provides endpoints to retrieve all email configurations and update a configuration, handling security and serialization.

classes.name: EmailConfigurationApiResource
classes.description: A REST controller class handling email configuration endpoints, secured with permissions and suitable for dependency injection.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch all email configurations, checking user permissions and serializing the configuration data to JSON.

methods.name: updateConfiguration
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update email configuration based on JSON input, logging the command, and returning the result as JSON.
